body:
GitHub beamfall/corvint#779, filed by the owner 2026-10-11. 

## Problem
`corvint impact`/`affected` select tests through imports; `flows impact` maps changes to declared flow intents. Neither answers "which screens and navigation edges does this change touch?" for template, controller, directive or route-file changes, so navigation proofs cannot be invalidated precisely and UI test selection falls back to all-or-nothing.

## Proposal
`corvint flows appmap impact --map FILE --base SHA [--ledger FILE]` emitting `application-map-impact/0`: changed paths -> anchored elements (screens via router/lineage anchors, steps/selectors via their anchors, templates/components via the contextindex import graph from the screen's declared component/template) -> affected edges -> tests that cross them (from join, test-sequence edges and receipts). Unknown hops are listed; any UNKNOWN reachable from a changed path forces a `full-suite-required` verdict for that app (fail closed).

## Acceptance criteria
- Router-file change invalidates the screen and all descendants (lineage).
- Template/component change reaches screens through declared component bindings; unbound templates read UNKNOWN.
- Output joins with the edge ledger: edges flipped from PROVEN to UNVERIFIED_AT_HEAD are listed with their cheapest re-proving test.
